description: Rank the 50 states and DC by class of 2026 SAT mean total, mean Math, mean Reading and Writing, participation rate, percent meeting both benchmarks, or number of test takers. Use min_participation_pct (for example 50) to compare only states where most students take the SAT, since low-participation states have higher means.

limit.description: How many states to return, 1 to 51. Default 10.

metric.description: What to rank by. Default mean_total.

min_participation_pct.description: Only include states with at least this participation rate, for example 50.

order.description: desc = highest first (default), asc = lowest first.

name: rank_states_by_sat
title: Rank states by SAT
